prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-01-08, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-01-08):
| Return 3m            | -25.4% |
| Return 1m            | -6.5% |
| Return 1w            | -3.4% |
| Range position (63d) | 0% |
| 21d realized vol     | 21% |
| Last close           | 90.53 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has shown persistent negative momentum with a 3-month return of -25.4% and recent declines across 1M and 1W. With a 21% realized volatility and no range positioning advantage, the downside risk appears more pronounced than upside potential over the next 20 trading days. Given the lack of positive catalysts and ongoing downside pressure, a SELL stance is warranted.

DECISION: SELL
